label: Generic Serial

payload_bytes.label: Payload
payload_bytes.description: Actual qualified API stream-chunk or application octets, not UART character/wire count. No universal8-byte default or65535 maximum.
payload_bytes.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

target_bus_load_percent.label: Ziel-Buslast
target_bus_load_percent.description: Zielwert fuer die aus Routing, Payload, Zyklus und Bitrate berechnete Buslast.

gs_mode.label: mode
gs_mode.description: Actual serial mechanism, unknown. A stream/COM-port name alone selects neither UART nor synchronous clocks nor native USB CDC.
gs_mode.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

gs_transport_binding.label: transport binding
gs_transport_binding.description: Required actual registered serial/USB/PHY port and direction topology reference; no silent RS232/RS485/SPI binding.
gs_transport_binding.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

gs_implementation_source.label: implementation source
gs_implementation_source.description: Required device/firmware/clock/driver capabilities and revision, unknown. Generic Serial is an NIS abstraction, not a normative serial bus.
gs_implementation_source.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

gs_framing_source.label: framing source
gs_framing_source.description: Required actual message encoding/framing/escaping/integrity and byte/character boundary source, unknown; stream chunks are not necessarily complete messages.
gs_framing_source.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

gs_uart_profile.label: uart profile
gs_uart_profile.description: Explicit source-qualified async UART framing profile, unknown. TB3216 tutorial supplies conditional9600/8N1 proposals, not universal baud minimum.
gs_uart_profile.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

gs_baud_rate.label: baud rate
gs_baud_rate.description: Actual async binary UART symbol rate, unknown until matched clock/divisor/configuration;9600 is conditional tutorial proposal, not generic minimum.
gs_baud_rate.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

gs_peer_baud_rate.label: peer baud rate
gs_peer_baud_rate.description: Actual peer configured baud rate; must agree with selected UART configuration. Clock error/oversampling tolerance needs actual device proof.
gs_peer_baud_rate.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

gs_data_bits.label: data bits
gs_data_bits.description: Actual data bits per UART character; reviewed AVR5..9, tutorial8. Not application octets or USB packet size.
gs_data_bits.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

gs_parity.label: parity
gs_parity.description: Actual UART parity; reviewed AVR NONE/EVEN/ODD only, tutorial NONE. Other devices require their own source.
gs_parity.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

gs_start_bits.label: start bits
gs_start_bits.description: Actual UART start bits; reviewed AVR/tutorial1. Unknown device-specific layouts are not verified using AVR limits.
gs_start_bits.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

gs_stop_bits.label: stop bits
gs_stop_bits.description: Actual UART stop-bit periods; reviewed AVR1 or2, tutorial1. Fractional stop periods are device-dependent.
gs_stop_bits.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

gs_char_bits.label: char bits
gs_char_bits.description: Actual start+data+parity+stop bit-periods per character. Tutorial8N1=10, AVR parity adds1. Not8 useful bits.
gs_char_bits.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

gs_encoded_characters.label: encoded characters
gs_encoded_characters.description: Actual serialized character count including framing/encoding/escaping/flow characters as applicable, unknown; not blindly equal to application payload octets.
gs_encoded_characters.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

gs_wire_bits.label: wire bits
gs_wire_bits.description: Actual UART occupied bit-period count = encoded characters times character bits; start/stop/parity included.
gs_wire_bits.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

gs_serialization_us.label: serialization us
gs_serialization_us.description: Actual UART serialization time = wire bit periods / binary UART baud times1e6, excluding actual gaps/flow stalls.
gs_serialization_us.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

gs_gap_bound_us.label: gap bound us
gs_gap_bound_us.description: Actual aggregate character/message/turnaround idle bound, unknown; zero only when explicitly justified.
gs_gap_bound_us.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

gs_flow_control.label: flow control
gs_flow_control.description: Actual UART flow control and peer support, unknown. No automatic disabled flow-control assumption.
gs_flow_control.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

gs_flow_bound_us.label: flow bound us
gs_flow_bound_us.description: Actual bounded UART flow-control blocking from both endpoints, unknown. Unbounded peer stalls do not prove capacity.
gs_flow_bound_us.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

gs_wire_bound_us.label: wire bound us
gs_wire_bound_us.description: Actual complete UART transfer bound at least serialization+aggregate idle+flow stalls, unknown; driver/application processing remains separate.
gs_wire_bound_us.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

gs_clock_hz.label: clock hz
gs_clock_hz.description: Actual synchronous serial clock, unknown. Encoding/bits per clock/edge/role/word lengths supplied by actual bound port; never UART baud or USB speed.
gs_clock_hz.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

gs_cdc_line_coding_role.label: cdc line coding role
gs_cdc_line_coding_role.description: Actual CDC implementation interpretation of line coding, unknown. Arduino native CDC ignores Serial.begin baud for wire speed; USB-to-UART bridges require separate real UART binding.
gs_cdc_line_coding_role.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

gs_framing.label: framing
gs_framing.description: Actual application message framing, unknown; optional line delimiters in TB3216 example are not mandatory for all serial streams.
gs_framing.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

gs_message_bytes.label: message bytes
gs_message_bytes.description: Actual application-message octets, unknown. Not API read/write chunk, UART characters, USB packets or encoded wire count.
gs_message_bytes.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

gs_max_message_bytes.label: max message bytes
gs_max_message_bytes.description: Actual implementation/application-message limit, unknown.65535 is not a generic serial standard maximum.
gs_max_message_bytes.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

parameter_proposals.note: Generic Serial has no universal physical rate. Explicit async TB3216 tutorial profile has conditional9600/8N1 proposals; sync and USB CDC require their own actual bound implementation.

known_limitations: Technology-specific conformance details require a vendor/profile extension.
